correctness.rationale: Gap G=M-X has geometric invariant distribution with λ=t(q+pλ²), t=1-r, for 0<r<1. Positive recurrence, ergodic frontier occupation, and martingale strong law give speed tp(1-λ); no-reset endpoint is max(2p-1,0), r=1 is zero. Reparameterizing by λ makes derivative sign q(1-2λ)-pλ², giving interior optimizer iff p<3/4 and critical boundary otherwise, with quadratic gain onset. Independent rational cases and 501-point reset grids checked. Uniform proof follows chain/derivative analysis, not sampled grids.
